scope: Proposition 7.7 of the manuscript “Parabolic intersections in Artin groups” (preprints/Parabolic-intersections-in-Artin-groups-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 254 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4cd7fa316371447c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 49-50. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Y ⊆ S be spherical and x ∈ A. For the family stabilizer H(Y, x) = {s ∈ AY : EL(sx) ≃ EL(x) for every L}, one of the following holds: 49 (i) all tests on e Y at x are acyclic and H(Y, x) = AY ; (ii) there exist p ∈ A+ Y and J ⊊ Y such that H(Y, x) ⊆ p−1 AJ p. (7.7)
